Looking at this question, I need to consider the effect of short tandem repeats (STRs) flanking transcription factor binding motifs on binding energetics.

This question refers to specific research on how flanking sequence context (short tandem repeats) affects the binding free energy of Pho4 (a yeast phosphate-regulation transcription factor) and Max (a human E-box binding factor).

The effect of flanking tandem repeats on DNA mechanics (bending, twisting, flexibility) can modestly alter the energetics of protein-DNA interactions. The reported tightening in binding when motifs are surrounded by short tandem repeats falls in the range of approximately 0.23-0.9 kcal/mol for these factors, representing a measurable but moderate enhancement in binding affinity.

[ANSWER]A[/ANSWER]
